newsitem.title: UK: IPE natural gas trades firmer, volumes swell.
newsitem.headline: IPE natural gas trades firmer, volumes swell.

text.p: IPE natural gas futures were steady to firmer for most months on Monday, reflecting strength on the physical markets, and volumes which changed hands in the morning were over half of those traded in the entirety of last week.
October natural gas traded 0.190 pence firmer at 12.400 pence while December and January 1998 traded 10 lots apiece, 0.125 pence and 0.155 pence stronger respectively at 14.600 and 17.775 pence.

"It is reflecting a buoyant OTC market which has been recovering from Thursday," one broker said, adding that physical markets were firmer across the board except for a stagnant fourth quarter of this year.
The front three months were untraded on the IPE but the wide bid/offer range for each month enclosed Friday's settlement price.
"The volumes were encouraging considering that we only had 70 lots for the whole of last week," the broker added.
"Hopefully with the OTC market being as it is there should be more business this afternoon. I wouldn't be surprised if there weren't another 50 lots today."
No system trades were executed on the flexibility market over the weekend. -- London newsroom +44 171 542 8167
